就在陈洛兮母女聊天时，王野来到了舅舅秦伟家。拐进一个没人的地方，从空间里拿出了一个羊腿和两条大鲤鱼。

最重要的是答应秦天悦的青蛙背包。一进院子就看见秦家兄妹四人在院子里，秦天熙和秦天韵在聊天，秦天翰和秦天悦在院子里玩儿。

看见王野进院最高兴的就是秦天悦了，她第一时间就看见了王野手中的背包。一路小跑的迎了上去。两只水灵灵的大眼睛直勾勾的盯着背包：“哥哥，哥哥这是给我的吗？”

王野蹲下笑呵呵的说道：“是呀，上次过来哥哥忘了拿了，这不专门给悦悦送一趟呀。”

秦天悦开心的接过背包，美滋滋的谢过王野后小跑着到秦天翰面前炫耀：“二哥，你看哥哥给我的，漂亮吧？你没有吧？”

不等秦天翰回话，小姑娘又跑到大姐秦天韵面前同样炫耀一遍。

王野一拍脑门儿心想：“这小丫头是不是在给他拉仇恨呀？”同时秦天翰那委屈又渴望的眼神看向王野。王野手伸进背包，迅速的在空间里做了一个陀螺和鞭子，对着秦天翰招招手说：“别看了，给你这个。”

秦天韵见弟弟妹妹都有了礼物也应了上来，拉着王野的手臂说：“弟弟，有大姐的吗？”

王野敢说没有吗，没见秦天韵的手已经放在了王野的手臂内侧了吗。王野赶紧伸进包里，从空间里拿出了一把梳子。

王野苦笑着把梳子递给秦天韵小声的说道：“大姐，这是金丝楠的绝对的好东西。”

这时秦天熙也凑了过来，王野赶紧警惕：“大哥你干嘛？”

秦天熙笑呵呵问道：“小野，他们可都有礼物，我呢？”

王野可没惯着哥哥的习惯理直气壮反问道：“大哥，你好意思管我要礼物吗？”

秦天熙嘴角一扬说：“那有什么不好意思的。”

王野把手里的羊腿和鱼递给秦天熙说：“大哥你拿着，我给你掏出来。”

秦天熙顺手接过东西，王野拿出一中华。想了一下拆开包拿出一根，自己点上。剩下的才给秦天熙装在上衣口袋了。

秦天熙这个气呀，撇着嘴说：“小野这就有点区别对待了吧，他们的礼物都是精心准备的。就给我一盒烟，你还拿一根儿。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“大哥你就知足吧，要是不愿意烟还给我。”说着就伸手去掏秦天熙的兜。

秦天熙哪能让进了自己口袋的东西再被要回去呢，拿着东西就进屋去了。王野和秦天韵也进屋了，只有秦天翰还在院子里研究陀螺。

一进客厅就看见李美娴正在训斥秦天悦，而小丫头躲在秦伟怀里偷偷的看着李美娴。王野上前问道：“舅妈，这是怎么了？”

李美娴一脸怒容：“小野啊，这是你给这臭丫头的吧？”

王野点点头，李美娴拿着小包：“你看看，这臭丫头把一袋白糖都倒进去了。”

秦天悦躲在秦伟怀里小声的嘟囔道：“妹妹包里就有糖。”

李美娴气笑了：“笑笑包里那是块糖，她也没装白糖呀。”

While Chen Luoxi and her daughter were chatting, Wang Ye came to his uncle Qin Wei's house.He turned into a deserted place and took out a leg of lamb and two large carp from the space.

The most important thing is to agree to Qin Tianyue's frog backpack.As soon as they entered the yard, they saw the four Qin brothers and sisters in the yard. Qin Tianxi and Qin Tianyun were chatting, and Qin Tianhan and Qin Tianyue were playing in the yard.

The happiest person to see Wang Ye enter the hospital was Qin Tianyue. She immediately saw the backpack in Wang Ye's hand.He trotted up to meet him.Two big, watery eyes stared straight at the backpack: "Brother, is this for me?"

Wang Ye squatted down and said with a smile: "Yes, my brother forgot to take it last time I came here. Isn't this a special trip to give to Yueyue?"

Qin Tianyue happily took the backpack, thanked Wang Ye happily and trotted to Qin Tianhan to show off: "Second brother, look at what my brother gave me. Is it beautiful? You don't have it, right?"

Without waiting for Qin Tianhan's reply, the little girl ran to her eldest sister Qin Tianyun and showed off again.

Wang Ye slapped his forehead and thought, "Is this little girl trying to bring hatred to him?" At the same time, Qin Tianhan looked at Wang Ye with aggrieved and longing eyes.Wang Ye reached into his backpack and quickly made a top and whip in the space. He waved to Qin Tianhan and said, "Don't look at it. I'll give you this."

When Qin Tianyun saw that her younger brothers and sisters had received gifts, she also responded. She took Wang Ye's arm and said, "Brother, is there any eldest sister?"

Dare Wang Ye say no? Didn't you see that Qin Tianyun's hand was already on the inside of Wang Ye's arm?Wang Ye quickly reached into his bag and took out a comb from the space.

Wang Ye smiled bitterly and handed the comb to Qin Tianyun and whispered: "Sister, this is an absolute good thing from Jinsunan."

At this time, Qin Tianxi also came over, and Wang Ye quickly alerted: "Brother, what are you doing?"

Qin Tianxi asked with a smile: "Xiaoye, they all have gifts, what about me?"

Wang Ye was not used to his brother's habit and asked confidently: "Brother, do you have the nerve to ask me for a gift?"

Qin Tianxi raised the corner of his mouth and said, "What's there to be embarrassed about?"

Wang Ye handed the leg of lamb and fish to Qin Tianxi and said, "Brother, take it and I'll take it out for you."

Qin Tianxi took the things smoothly, and Wang Ye took out a Chinese.After thinking for a moment, he opened the bag, took out one, and lit it himself.Qin Tianxi put the rest in his jacket pocket.

Qin Tianxi was so angry that he curled his lips and said, "Xiaoye must treat them a little differently. Their gifts are carefully prepared. Just give me a box of cigarettes, and you can take one."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Brother, just be content. If you don't want to give the cigarette back to me." After saying that, he reached for Qin Tianxi's pocket.

How could Qin Tianxi let the things that went into his pockets be taken back again? He took the things and went into the house.Wang Ye and Qin Tianyun also entered the house, only Qin Tianhan was still studying the top in the yard.

As soon as he entered the living room, he saw Li Meixian scolding Qin Tianyue, while the little girl was hiding in Qin Wei's arms and secretly watching Li Meixian.Wang Ye stepped forward and asked, "Auntie, what's going on?"

Li Meixian looked angry: "Xiaoye, you gave this to this stinky girl, right?"

Wang Ye nodded, and Li Meixian took the small bag: "Look, this stinky girl poured a bag of sugar into it."

Qin Tianyue hid in Qin Wei's arms and whispered softly: "Sister, there is candy in the bag."

Li Meixian laughed angrily: "That's a piece of candy in Xiaoxiao's bag, she didn't put any sugar either."
